description: This file defines a Java class LocalTimeJsonConverter which implements JSON serialization and deserialization for java.time.LocalTime objects, integrating with Jackson for JSON processing.

classes.name: LocalTimeJsonConverter
classes.description: A JSON converter for LocalTime objects, providing methods to serialize and deserialize LocalTime to and from JSON strings.

methods.name: convertToObject
methods.description: Converts a JSON string representing a local time into a LocalTime object using a parser.

methods.name: convertToJson
methods.description: Serializes a LocalTime object into a JSON string using a generator.

methods.name: convertedType
methods.description: Returns the class type this converter handles, which is LocalTime.
